children: Idaho Copper completed an NYSE American uplisting and an underwritten offering raising approximately $18.0 million while advancing an updated PEA for the CuMo project.
Uplisted to the NYSE American; common stock and warrants began trading under COPR and COPR WS to boost visibility and liquidity.
Completed underwritten public offering for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $18.0 million, strengthening the balance sheet.
Appointed five independent board members and an independent audit committee to align governance with NYSE American standards.
Expanded management: Bruce Harmon named CFO; Robert Scannell named Executive Chairman; added technical and ESG directors.
Updated PEA for the CuMo project progressing on schedule; study will reflect smaller first-phase plant, sensor-based ore sorting, and re-sequenced mine plan.
